children: Liberty Media named Philip J. Boeckman Chief Legal Officer, effective October 1, 2026, and Renee L. Wilm will transition to Senior Advisor on the same date.
To assume oversight of legal functions
To provide strategic guidance and counsel while supporting key initiatives

Former Partner at Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP (1999–2026); prior roles include Associate (1991), Managing Partner London (2000 onward), Co‑Head of EMEA Capital Markets; corporate and cross‑border capital markets experience; J.D. magna cum laude, Univ. of Missouri.
Will continue to provide strategic guidance and counsel to the leadership team and support key initiatives across the Company.
